runtime_profiles.function: short event/request-driven execution; no dedicated always-on tenant runtime
runtime_profiles.scheduled: timer/cron initiated execution in shared runtime
runtime_profiles.durable: may wait/retry across minutes or days without holding a dedicated tenant server
runtime_profiles.human_loop: durable workflow with explicit human decision
runtime_profiles.heavy: OCR/batch/compute-heavy work; must be metered and may use an optional heavy-job runtime
